page.layout: One printed page of text. Running head at top centre. Numbered summary verses 10–21 in the main column, in italic. Below them a centred heading in large capitals, followed by a mnemonic word list with chapter numbers set above the words. No margin notes.

p.i: 10 Mortem pastor adit. num sis edicito Christus? Peccone,si patrem dico me habere Deum?
11 Nuper functus eras fato: nunc Lazare viuis. Vni pro toto mors subeunda grege est.
12 Offendit Nardus, caue Lazare: vox ruit alto. Non credunt signis, mundus honorque placent.
13 Plantas Christe lauas, male sano porrigis offam. Das insigne tuis, tristificasque Petrum.
14 Quis timor iste? locum paro. sum via. crede Philippe, Spiritus adveniet. mox rediturus eo.
15 Reiectus palmes, dilectio nostris amici Omnia, quos mecum non bene mundus amat.
16 Spiritus afflictis aderit, mundumque notabit. Pro lachrymis rediens gaudia plena dabo.
17 Tempus adest vt glorificer. nunc cuncta peregi. Da bona discipulis quae peto sancte pater.
18 Vis armata ruit, cædis bone Petre, negasque. Pontifices arguunt, multa Pilate rogas.
19 Abs re cur damnem? reticem? inscriptio sortes. Astans virgo sitis, fractio crurum aloe.
20 Eini concurrunt. Mariase monstrat Iesus. Bis pax inquit eis. Thoma videto manus.
21 Conspiciunt septem Dominum Petre curris in undis. Cura pastor oues, meque sequare ducem.

main_text.head: VOCABULA MEMORIALIA, SINGULA EX SINGULIS CAPITIBUS, quina vero uno versu hexametro comprehensa.
main_text.l: Sum Panis, Mysta, stat Adultera, Coecus, Ouile,
Faenus, Libra, Pedes, Christus, Via, Palmites, estis

page.notes: Page is a printed signature-free page; the right-hand edge shows the neighbouring page and show-through, which are excluded. Uncertain readings: "Eini" in verse 20 [?]; "Mysta, stat" in the word list may be "Mystat" [?]; "Abs re" in verse 19 is unclear. Printing errors left as printed: "adueniet" (read as adveniet), "grege'est" (read as grege est). Verse 15 "bene" is partly obscured. Verse 11 "functus" read through a damaged ligature.
